comment: This was the toughest RUCK I have ever done. The last time I did this 10+ kilometre route I was carrying 20 pound dumbbells. Since then I have upgraded to 25 and man was it tough. The little bitch voice in your head told me not to take both of them, to stop earlier, not complete the course, and each time I said no. Unfortunately my phone locked out and when I got to the end I had to wait nine minutes before I could stop my phone and I had to get driving so my true distance was only 10.5 km.

The first five kilometers are a great walk, followed by 1.5km of kind of miserable road walking in suburbia, followed by 1km of asphalt multi-use trail between backyards and a forest that is fine. 

I think your best bet is to walk the ‘U’ part of the map out and back (totalling 10km if you do this). Secondarily, I would recommend walking the trail backwards compared to the map, getting the suburban misery out of the way first and then saving the nice 5km to the end. 

Streetside parking on Westdel Bourne is great.

Awesome ruck with 92 pounds in 40 pound weight vest, a 20 pound dumbbell any hand and a 12 pound ankle weight. Longest one in a while if ever with this much weight. The barefoot shoes need to be replaced though as there are too many holes in them

We started the loop by going right and we were sad at the concrete everything. BUT THEN… voila! It opened into beauty and just got better and better. Well groomed, not difficult, really pretty, and quiet. We’ll be back!
Ground was still frozen
Snow covered with muddy spots. Pole use recommended.
Beautiful sunny day with good snow conditions
Nice trail along the river with beautiful fall colors.

Great hike
Longer trail
Finish with about 25 minutes of houses
beautiful trail
Beautiful trail right in the city!  Loved it!
Do not do the full loop! The last half is a boring cement bike / sidewalk on busy streets
Nice easy trail, good conditions, bit of elevation. Only complaint is last third is just a walk through the subdivisions, better to just go out and back.
Love the greenery and lots of fun critters to see!
This is a great trail - a total hidden gem nestled in the northern part of West5. The trails are beautiful. Somewhat technical. Along the water. Very pretty. Some hills. Loved it!
Other then the back half being threw a naighbour hood its a amazing trail

Nice trail very nice path well kept not Maddy at all this time of year, I would say moderate trail.
Only thing is the side we enter the trail there is no proper parking, we parked on the street in front of a house.

well maintained trails with little bit muddy and majority of trails is in shade and small parts on paved road across some beautiful houses 
Elevations of trails change couple of times and mostly its flat and covered by wooden bridge 
The day I hiked was gorgeous sunny day and sunshine made  thames river more vibrant with beautiful views of birds geese 
Overall very good trails marking and signage of trails is very clear untill last point 
Worth visiting and would comeback again soon
Nice, moderate trail
Trail in the woods was great! Didn’t love walking through a neighborhood for the second half as much

This was a great hike with my dogs. Very shaded so doable even during the middle of a summer day. A few easy access spots to the river. Parking was a breeze. If you don't want to walk through the neighborhoods at the end, you'll want to turn around when you first start seeing houses, around mile 3.2 (sorry, from the US). A fair amount of flies so plan on spray.
Beautiful trail that’s well maintained, great for biking, running or hiking

My favourite trail, there is hardly any litter on the ground and the views and hike is spectacular. A little muddy in spots, but I did go the day after the rain. 

Would be nice if dog owners didn’t treat nice places as their personal trash cans. Disappointing to see dog poo bags. If I can walk my garbage out, so can you. If you don’t wanna carry your dog’s poo, maybe don’t bring your dog.
One of our favourite hikes simple, easy and a nice path to walk along
Beautiful trail, feels like you’re fully outside of the city
Looks of good lookouts over the water ! Was slippery due to rain earlier in the day but that made it that much more enjoyable. Would definitely recommend

Pretty busy today but to be expected on such a lovely day!  Lots of wild life out!! I saw garder snakes,  chipmunks,  deer, and ducks.  It didn't feel like you were surrounded by subdivisions and golf courses.

It’s a great environment with fresh air. I’m looking forward to late spring and summer, when everything will be covered in green grass and leaves.
One thing to be aware of: families with pets should be careful. I saw a snake on our walkway—it could hurt our dogs.
So stay safe, and have a wonderful time!

Such a beautiful trail. Not crowded (Saturday evening) - majority of the trail through the forest with nice views. Some muddy patches still from rain a few days ago, but not horrible. Looking forward to going back soon.
Great trail with beautiful views, would recommend waiting for river to lower, as many of the areas on the path are close to the river and are underwater from recent rainfall.

I used cross country skiis which was fun but not easy.  Snow shoes would have been much better as there are too many zig zags to manoever.  A few hills one of which i took off my skiis to go down. (Old knees -wont risk it)
Late Afternoon Walk with Murphy.
great view,like it so much
Very buggy, hardly any mud.
Long and hilly but beautiful! Some portion of trail is along roads for the loop.
Great trail and amazing views. Water is still moving fast after the rain, and a few muddy spots, but still manageable.

Nice trail, largely shaded (on the trail portion itself); as other uses have said, to complete this as a loop you will start or finish by walking the sidewalk through the neighbour hood.  Quite washed out and muddy today due to recent rain fall; definitely a challenge to pick a clear path in some places without soaking feet or slipping.  Fair amount of bugs as well.
Part of this path is through the neighborhood if you only want to stay on the trail it will be more of a in and out trail
Great out and back trail along the River and within the city. 4.5 km / hr makes this trail doable in 2.5hrs. Safe and well worth the visit
Some muddy spots, great trail for a run or hike! Lots of people on the trail, didn’t get eaten alive!
Great trail! Beautiful! Kids are tired but enjoyed it! They should sleep well tonight!
Amazing trail today
A bit muddy in a few spots but there are paths around or rocks and sticks laid down, beautiful trail, doesn’t even feel like London
Long but amazing
A little muddy in areas but not too bad. Don’t wear your best footwear..
A little wet and muddy because of recent rain but a very nice hike. Saw a few interesting birds including a scarlet tanager and Baltimore oriole.
Trail in good condition. A few muddy spots but easily avoided. Lots of birds .
Great hike with my mom for her birthday. Maybe we started a new tradition. Decent conversation and good company.
Trail is very nice. The last 2km is through the streets of a neighborhood
calm walk with lots of beautiful views and lots of greenery!!
Great trail! Now is the time to go — zero bugs.
Great day to grab a quick one with my dad on his birthday. Too bad we got ripped off on the distance as the app stopped recording. Ffs…. Should be over 10 km instead of 6.3 km.
Nice hike along the river. Some nice ups and downs, few muddy areas but nothing too bad. Lots of parking along Kaines rd.
A bit muddy. Trail in good shape
Good conditions
Very little mud, nicely packed mostly.
Great trail, a bit muddy
A bit of mud but not too bad

Very icy and muddy. Parts of the trail are flooded and had to turn back as the bridge was under water. River is flowing high and rapid. Wear proper foot gear, and bring trekking poles for extra stability.  Waterproof hikers are a must with wet, muddy and icy conditions
Beautiful soft crunchy snow and sunshine - nothing better
Excellent but be prepared for lots of mud
Mostly good trail conditions with common wet, slippery mud patches.
Really wet and mucky in certain points

Lovely trail. A bit muddy and slippery in a few spots that definitely made for stepping carefully.
Definitely a repeat trail!
Little muddy in some spots. The mud made hills quite slippery. Other then that an absolutely beautiful trail.
Beautiful! No words!
Very nice hike on this beautiful autumn afternoon!
Wonderful trail with a mix of flat and uphill hiking for beginner hikers. Great for mountain biking. We walked to Oxford Rd and headed back to avoid the residential area.

Well maintained trail with nice points of elevation. I hiked from the entrance at Westdel Bourne to the exit at Oxford Street then back again instead of circling back through the residential area. Took me 2-2.5 hours.

Training for an overnight backpacking trip so brought my backpack filled with all my gear that I will need at the end of the month. 49.7 pounds in tow for this hike. Really started to feel it by the last home stretch had to readjust the pack a few times. I probably should re-pack it to improve it. This route should be its own trail aside from the present “Kains Woods Trail”. The down and back along the river both ways is epic. It was good and dark when we finished at 8:35 pm so definitely start earlier at this time of year if you want to do it through the forest the whole way. And watch out for toads! Trail is absolutely littered with them.
Great little practice run for our upcoming back country trip. Nice to do it today with sold backpacks and hiking polls. Back to the lab to fine tune a little more.
Trail is well maintained, well marked and easy. Would do it again

Trail was in great condition - a little muddy in some areas but to be expected. 
Great morning walk!

First 3km or so is paved if you are using this as a training ground for a tough mudder or cross country run.

You might want to try and find one of the midway points and grab the internal cross country runs, which is in the forest.
Nice trail. Takes about two hours if walking at leisurely pace. Lots of trees and shaded. Suggest using mosquito repellent before entering the trail.
Lots of mosquitoes, a little muddy but not too bad
Best trail in London not including the short stroll through the subdivision. Reminds us every time of the beautiful trails in Ontario. Absolutely stunning any month of the year.

Trail was beautiful, a gem to he enjoyed. Definitely consider it of moderate intensity as many hills up and down along a river setting. Still muddy in spots. Took us longer than suggested, approximately two hours including the loop back through the residential area. Definitely would return
A bit muddy but trail was beautiful! I brought my dog with me as well, she really enjoyed it.
Great hike!
Wooded trail is in great shape with a few new boardwalks this season.  Only not fun part is the 2k walk back to the car along a bicycle path beside the road.  Hike is also known as Kains Woods.
Nice but still bothers me that you walk through a subdivision the last 20 mins or so of the trail.
Beautiful trail with great views. Muddy in spots. I was very thankful I brought my poles for the hills. Lol

A good  extended loop that entails ducking under the Oxford Street W bridge at the eastern end of the Kains Woods trail, walking up the south side of Oxford towards Commisioners and then linking up to the Warbler Woods trails. Trail conditions were dry and excellent on the day we walked this one.

35lbs pack
Trail got washed out. Had to turn back
The Thames River is currently flooding so the Kains Woods trail is very muddy or washed out in numerous places
Snow has melted resulting in mud and runoff water
Still a fair bit of snow and mud making it quite slippery in spots. Beautiful hike, will give it 5 stars in the summer when it's not as treacherous.
Live this trail.  Was more muddy than I'd hoped for, but still great
Slippery

It was a perfect day for a ten km hike. Trail was very icy. You need  icers on your boots 
Parking is limited.

Hike within the woods along the river is really nice. First time I went, I did the loop along the roadway and hated it. When I went back I just doubled back along the wooded trail and was much happier!
Part of trail is paved along side roads
Not really a loop as the straight bits are just walking through soulless subdivisions but the trail itself is amazingly gorgeous and fun
Beautiful time of year for a hike with the leaves changing colour.

Great trail through the forest along the water. Some spots where you can access the water. The only downside is walking through a neighbourhood for the last third of the loop. I wish there was a shortcut that made the loop more direct through forest the entire way. Beautiful in the forest though, fairly easy with just some spots of incline.
Beautiful trail. Well kept.
Gem in the city but half of the trail goes through neighbourhood
A good trail and so much wildlife when you go in the evening around 7:30.
Excellent shake down run
Great morning hike before the heat of the day
great morning hike nice weather and friendly people along the route

Loved it! I went clockwise on this loop so I had the street part at the end. Beautiful mature hardwood forest along the river and a few pines mixed in along the way. This is a “Must Try” trail for anyone in the area.
A bit muddy and slick due to earlier rain.
Not too hot and always some great scenery if you’re looking for it!
great trail. amazing views and doable inclines!

Needed a mental health break this afternoon so I booked out early and bolted for the woods with the dog. ￼nature sure didn’t disappoint. Trilliums and all the other newly budding leaves and minus the bugs make this a perfect time of year to get out. Also found a nice little salamander under a log and in some leaves. Wish my kids and wife were here!
Beautiful weather and amazing hike. Trail was great for most people. Lots to see along the way.
excellent hike the trail was mostly in good condition the odd muddy spot today , weather was ideal thoroughly enjoyable
really beautiful first half some road walking but worth it.
Nice trail… ran out of time to complete.  Nice signs of Spring…. Including bugs!
Beautiful To get another day of hiking with snow… Especially after work￼
Great first day of spring hike!

What an amazing hike with beautiful scenery on this wintry day but the people we met along the trail was even better. Several breaks to chat made this trail a lot longer for time but it was well worth the conversation to meet Canadian patriots of all ages. Especially Russ and Madonna. They are in our pictures and they will be coming to our house for dinner someday when it warms up! It was rocks right￼￼
Beautiful well marked trail through the woods along the Thames River.  Wear hiking boots with slip on ice spikes to keep your footing on the various icy slopes along the trail.
Very nice trail. Quite icy in spots. Lovely view of the river the dogs loved it
Great hike! Beautiful scenery. Didn't feel like we were in a city at all . Highly recommend!
Can be muddy when it rains . Over all great walk! Long, but very into the woods! You also walk along the water

A wonderfully wooded area for hiking with a water shed and a river walk. Lots of elevation in parts including a rather narrow slope walk halfway through. In order to do the full loop you have to walk through a couple of subdivisions and roadways, which is unfortunate.
Lovely place to view the spring flowers.
well used as this is a well maintained trail...some railings on steep hills.  great changes in elevations for trail running enthusiasts.
Great trail with views of the river and a swimming spot for the pup around half way to cool off
Nice views of the river! The last kilometer is through a neighborhood and it can be fairly busy in spots, but otherwise a great trail!

Great trail! Paved part ends when you get past the neighborhood and down into the valley.  Some hilly parts on either end of the trail; flat in the middle.  Trail is very well marked, path is clear and wide enough to pass others. Lightly trafficked. Would be a great running trail if thats your thing.  

This trail can be done as a loop if you don't mind walking through the neighborhood for a 1/2 the loop.  I chose to go back the way I came, but it added about 35min to my hike.
awesome views.  too bad it was raining.
great trail for walking and even trail running, if you don't mind a couple of narrow steep parts.
Hot and humid outside, but nice inside the forest. Really quite busy despite getting out so early!

Lovely trail with lots of shade and nice views. Doesn't loop around. Takes an hour to go from one end of trail to the other end. And then you either have to walk back or loop around to your car through the neighbourhood, which will probably take another half an hour (shorter than going back on same trail but no shade or views).
A little muddy, but beautiful trail.
Great trail! Very confusing at some parts— not entire trail is wooded? Still great trek!
Beautiful morning run! Lots of runners out here today.

This trail is 5km of really nice single dirt track along a very picturesque section of the Thames river. Various elevations make it a moderate challenge. On the other end of the spectrum over 2km of this trail is through a newly constructed high end private and gated community housing London’s more affluent citizens. You could alway do a there and back trip to enjoy the peaceful walk along the river and extend the trip by a few kilometres, that is what I am planning for next trip.
Trail well maintained and super dry today foliage filled in so it was difficult to see the river.
Probably the prettiest place to walk along the Thames River in London Ontario
Quite busy on the trails today, but nice to see so many people out!
well marked trail. lots of runners some spots or pretty narrow for traffic both ways.
Amazing trail
It is absolutely beautiful. My dog came with me and she loved it. 10/10!
good
Great day for a walk !
First time at this trail and WOW. The pictures just don't do this beautiful place justice. The green, the final climb, the peace!!! Get out there and breathe friends. You certainly won't regret it!!
Great scenery .. lovely hike
Ideal conditions for running with a little tack on the trail. Lots of smiling and kind people on the trails today!
Lovely hike, moderate to hard towards the end of the trail. If you’re looking for something easy to moderate just do the first half and head back the way you came.
Beautiful day on the trails. Crossed maybe 25 other people, most of which were runners. Nice to see so many happy people enjoying the trails!
Great in the forest! Very busy trail. The last part of the loop is in a subdivision so kinda boring there
Nice Sunday hike.
Great day for a hike. A few muddy spots still and a moderate amount of traffic but still nice and peaceful.

great trail! lots of photogenic points through the trail. Love the community effort with the post it's through it with motivational quotes and hand painted km markers. One thing I wish they would of done is mark where the loop turns (so we know when to turn) as we got lost and ended up in town.
Loved it! Perfect day for it. The mud is drying, the green is coming out. Counter to the last person’s review all dogs were leashed during my walk. Get out there. :)

Great trail! Beautiful! 
Too many dog owners with dogs off leash but otherwise really nice! 
Dry!
nice and hilly. fairly busy but easy to social distance. not muddy at all.
Good path, moderate traffic and a few muddy places but quite scenic for inside the city
some muddy spots but a nice spring walk in the woods
Was beautiful along the river. Saw two deer and a beaver. Definitely recommend. Part of loop is through residential, but beautiful homes to look at on way back to parking spot.
Great walk along river.

Taking advantage of a day off and running Kains, Warbler, and Sifton Bog. Kains was in great conditions with very few soft spots. Great trail for running with a nice technical section near Oxford entrances. Will definitely do this one often this year.
Beautiful trail but the last quarter is in residential.￼￼
Nice and muddy but just a beautiful day for a hike.
Very pretty, but you definitely need ice grippers right now.
Awesome trail! Very icy in spots (personal reminder: buy crampons) but so beautiful all along the river
Icy
Very steep icy spots
lots of ice atm
Nice trail, super icy. Signage states coyote in area and I did find blood on the trail, so keep your pups leashed!!

Icy in spots with some narrow trails along cliff edge. Wear spikes. Avoid the boring 30 minute walk through suburbia and take an in-out route instead. Very busy, nearly no distancing attempted, not super pandemic friendly. I’d wait until summer before “hiking” it again.
Great trail along the River. Very crisp afternoon!
Excellent hike down river valley out of the winter wind
Beautiful in the forest but the last 2k is on residential side walks
Beautiful snow covered trail in the Thames valley
Slippery trail winter but so beautiful
Great hike but definitely icy in spots, making it more treacherous. Don’t forget your crampons or Yaks tracks!
Great but Skip
Trail was very icing in spots. Took about 2.5 hours to complete. Trail consists of some paved sections, but mostly in woods. Great views.
It’s a gorgeous trail but very icy and muddy and extremely busy. Felt like a mall on a Saturday before Christmas. Way too busy to enjoy.
Very pretty- good amount of traffic considering how hilly, icy and muddy it was
Very slippery today with the snow/ice/mud combo!
Icy in some spots, hiking sticks or shoe grips a good idea but ok without.
Another beautiful trail close to home.
Great!!
Very muddy today!
Some trees down nothing impassable.
Perfect
City added rails along “The Ledge”, great job!
Great easy hike with nice views of the river. The last part of the walk back to our vehicle is through a subdivision but it was still a very nice loop.
Awesome! So beautiful!
Good condition, a little muddy at times.
Beautiful
I like it so much that I did the loop twice
I’d say it’s a rather easy trail. Loved the fall color of the forest section.

Went Sun. Sept. 6 - Labour Day weekend - not busy. 
Parking is on any street you find by homes since the first half of the trail is in a residential area on a sidewalk - so flat and easy terrain. We felt strange waking with our backbacks while people were out casually walking were around us.
Unclear after as to how to get into the forest trail which was easy-moderate. We hit a main street and then found the entrance back behind a home with unclear signage. Therefore, use GPS and not just a map to help you out. You then eventually get to the stream and it is then lovely for a London trail.

Would have been an easy five stars if not for the paved portion of the loop. The forest and river views were magical, and the trail is varied and winding. Watch your step now that the leaves have fallen and are hiding tripping hazards.  If you’re worried about social distancing, go early in the day - it was really crowded on a Saturday afternoon.
Always a good trail but gets busy on nice days. Fall colours are worth it.
Awesome place, so beautiful
Easy trail through diverse woods along bank of Thames. Access is from residential streets so limited parking.
Gorgeous trail!  A combination of a relaxing walk and a few hills to keep it interesting.  Beautiful nature throughout!
Super awesome
someone said on here that this may be the best trail in London, so naturally I had to come check it out. That person wasn't exaggerating. Definitely my favorite
This trail is amazing, by far my favourite in London.

My boyfriend and I have gone to many trails in London however we never knew about this one until I downloaded this app! It was really long, but absolutely beautiful. Usually we have to load on the mosquito repellent, but this trail had hardly any bugs! It was shady for most of it which was nice. We saw a Blue Haren at the river which was really cool! It’s definitey not meant for beginners as there are steep edges and lots of hills as well as rocks, but all around our favourite trail yet!

I did the trail counterclockwise and did not enjoy the first 2-3 km through a neighborhood. I really enjoyed the rest of the trail though and next time would do a “thru and back” of the forest part. It was quite busy for a Monday morning but everyone was courteous and social distancing as best they could. Lovely trail, would go again!
Good Trail, lots of hills and technical places, can get busy.
Amazing. Need child carriers for the twins!

my husband wanted to go for hike and I suggested this trail, and boy oh boy are my legs and feet killing! my daughter enjoyed all the nature we saw, from toads, to toadlets, to spiders, snails, birds, chipmunks and deer. if this your first time hiking it's a tough one but manageable.
Easy - moderate trail. A little difficult to follow, went off course a bit. All in all, great trail with lots of shade. Quiet, not many others on trail.
Holy I definitely struggled after this one... definitely bring lots of water and be prepared for hilly terrains!
One of my new favorites! Absolutely stunning trail.
One of my favourite trails in London. Great for jogging.
Beautiful hike along the Thames! Loved it here, will com back 100%!
Wasn’t a big fan of walking through condo areas but the actual trail was beautiful and my kids loved it
Excellent trail. Great views of the river. In good condition.
Beautiful... just beautiful... all the way through!  Great place to get my run in.  Love it!
Great spot for a hike, a couple of narrow spots on high ledges. But the rest is great.

First time going, 5/17/2020. The rain started coming down as I reached the river and wow, it was such a beautiful experience. The trail was very well marked so I was confident of where I was going and surprised by how nice the scenery was. Lovely way to get your 10 thousand or more steps. Easily my favourite trail in London. :)
Beautiful trail! Best in the city. Well marked, lovely scenery, interesting path. The trail is mostly along the river in the woods with a short part along roads.

Great trail with good elevation changes. Quite a few places where there are big roots and rocks sticking out of the path so keep an eye on where you’re walking. A little muddy in one or two lower spots, and the dirt can be loose close to the edge of a higher cliff spot so be careful of your footing. Overall awesome trail (and SO beautiful!).
Favourite trail in the city!!
Gorgeous trail!! Part is on sidewalk but quiet areas. Parts of path by river can be a bit narrow so social distancing can be somewhat tricky.
Really dry today, only a bit muddy in 2-3 spots. Such a beautiful trail. We prefer to do the out and back route with a turn around at the subdivision gate for 10km hike

Really good trail - not overly hard but does have some ups and downs which makes it better than a flat trail!
Slightly muddy, but only on some low spots 
I second someone’s suggestion of turning around at the end of the trail and walking back through the Bush, other wise you will be walking through town by the houses
Great day for hiking today. Trail was in excellent condition and not busy at all.

My favorite trail in London.

It's a great view, follows the river from higher up, a bit muddy in the spring, it takes a bit to get to the trail. 

I recommend you take the trail to the end and follow it back instead of walking the loop thru the streets on the way back.

It's got some inclines so great for training as well.

Awesome views takes about a 1km before you get to the river and boy is the view nice on top I only went about 1/4 way in the trail as I was birding mud on some of the steep hills in the winter but nothing unmanageable
Great trail!  Well maintained. Muddy in spots but to be expected as we went on a mild day in December. Beautiful views of the river.

Really pretty trail in London that gets you close to the river. We went right after a snowfall and it was beautiful! Careful during winter as there is a section that gets quite icy and you have to rely on rope attached to trees to avoid slipping.
Awesome trail! Would not recommend baby wearing here though. Thin angled paths next to some steep drops.
Loved this trail on a cool autumn day! I can see hat it might get slippery in places after or during a rain
Fantastic trail! Took my 5 and 3 yr old along and they had a great time. Definitely tired by the end but it was a great afternoon.

Nice trail with pretty forest and views of the Thames. To make it a loop, you have to do a fair bit of walking through residential area. Fun to ogle at some of the massive houses but all over too much street walking. Next time will definitely just make it an out-and-back.
Some parts of the trail are closed for maintenance.
Beautiful trail! Wonderful views of the river, and wonderful views of the three-story houses! A little tricky in spots.
great trail. lots of fun
Fantastic hike, highly recommended it. Be aware of weather as it can get muddy after rain.
Great run through the woods and along the river that ends  with tour through suburbs back to my car.
Beautiful trail! The whole loop took us just under 2 hours. Bring lots of water!
Nice hike along the Thames River, and not a lot of traffic. The last part was along bike trail in the adjacent neighbourhood.
Challenging enough for a nice afternoon stroll with my 9yo daughter. she was tired by the end.
I loved it I had lots if fun especially when I hit a rock and fell.

Nice trail for London with some elevation changes. Typical wildlife presence of deer, chipmunks, and small birds. Mostly shaded. I recommend doubling back when you get to the end of the trail. Last 1/3 of the loop seems to be through suburbia, with no shade in sight... murder on a hot day.

We completed this in 2:14 (taking our time - no rush). Wonderful scenery and lots of wildlife! We went a day after a very heavy rainfall. It was moderately muddy in some spots, but lots of trees kept most of the trail from becoming saturated. Loved the trail! Gets more challenging in some spots. Great for all levels of fitness.
Nice trail. Fairly flat and easy. Saw multiple deer, cranes, and heard some coyotes in the distance.
Love this trail! Would recommend going when it’s dry because it does get muddy. Fairly easy path, with stairs and ropes when needed
Lovely hike, but muddy after rain or snow but overall beautiful place
Variety of terrains good hiking. Some narrow sections. Would recommend poles and icers if it's been cold and snowy.
Love this trail! One of the best London has to offer
one of most beautiful trails in London Area. Surprised, I saw three little snakes within two trips in fall.
Really nice trail but only road parking.
My favourite trail to run and hike in the area. Well groomed for the most part with some wildlife perks every so often.

Lovely trail! As others have mentioned, the down side is the long walk through the suburbs, back to the parking. We have done it two other ways: one where we turn around after an hour or so to walk back through the forest, the other where we have left our bikes at the other end to bike back to the car. Both worked great!
Great trail, maybe my new favorite in london. Well kept trail. However there is no designated parking, and the long walk back to my vehicle. Will hike here again
Very nice trail. Width of the trail varies greatly, but elevation changes keep the trail very refreshing.

Lovely trail. Very shaded. Easy except does have quite a few hills. I did what one other reviewer said, which was turn around when the trail popped out of the woods. Make for just over 12km, took about 3 hours.
Great trail. Only sad part was the long walk back to my car!
Great hike! Although I did not like how it cut through a neighbourhood, however it was kind of necessary to get to the bike trail.
Say a couple coyotes in there today but otherwise it's beautiful,
Amazing trail. So beautiful and peaceful, highly recommend!
First time for my Golden and I. Great trail. Friendly people and friendly dogs. Wish I had this app and iPhone with me!

Great trail in the North end of the city. There is some mud & a bit of brush covering the path, but considering this was the first nice weekend of the year it was phenomenal!  We saw some others on the trail, but unfortunately not much wildlife this time around

We love this beautiful trail beside the river and can’t wait to see it change with seasons. The only disappointment is the final kilometre through the neighbourhood on the sidewalk. Next time, we’ll turn around at 5 km and head back the way we came for a 10 km hike. Other than that, it’s perfect!
Fantastic trail along the river for all season hiking.  I see deer quite often, and it's usually not too busy.  It's a nice hidden gem in London!
Nice trail along the river. Wouldn't recommend taking a small dog as there are coyotes (any time of day)
Very nice trail. We saw a Red Tail Hawk, two Golden Eagles and a Bald Eagle. Trail is well mark very easy to find even with the snow. Crampons would be a good idea as some spots are slippery.
Dears are often running around in the woods.
Very nice hike, not very challenging.
